name: LoResMT 2021 — shared task (test)
description: LoResMT 2021 Shared Task test sets — English ↔ Irish and English ↔ Marathi, COVID-domain public-health content (per-direction test files; ga→en is 250 sentences, the rest 500). Fetched on demand from the shared-task repo at a pinned commit; Champollion never hosts the content. Domain 'humanitarian' (COVID public-health, TICO-19 precedent). Contamination HIGH — public since 2021 — so scores are relative-comparison-only. License CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 → non-commercial lanes only; cleared by the license review of 2026-08-24 into the NC research lane: benchmarkable; never in a commercial, prize, or API lane; remote evaluation only over no-train channels.

segments.name: LoResMT 2021 test
segments.purpose: MT evaluation — held-out shared-task test set (relative-comparison-only)

download.instructions: data/{pair}/test.{direction}.{code} files fetched from the pinned commit (immutable), line-parallel two-file pairing; the pair directory is fixed while the file prefix encodes the direction.

source.citation: LoResMT 2021 Shared Task on COVID and Sign Language for low-resource languages (Ojha et al., 2021), 4th Workshop on Technologies for MT of Low Resource Languages (MT Summit 2021).

license.aiTraining: Held-out shared-task test set; not licensed for training. doNotTrain protects benchmark integrity.
license.notes: LICENSE file present at the pinned commit (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0). NC → non-commercial lanes only. Champollion never hosts the content.

usageRestrictions.communityNotes: Held-out shared-task benchmark: training on it defeats its purpose. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 → kept out of every commercial / prize / API lane. Content is fetched from source, never hosted.

contamination.reasoning: LoResMT 2021 test sets — public since 2021. Scores are valid only for relative method-vs-method comparison on this exact corpus, never as absolute quality. Forced HIGH here and via build_registry.HELD_OUT_BENCHMARK_FAMILIES.

licenseReview.basis: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, stated and verified at the pinned revision. Plain standard SPDX non-commercial license: benchmarkable; excluded from every commercial, prize, and API lane; remote evaluation only over channels that do not train on inputs (transmission_policy no-train lane).

_provenance.populatedFrom: https://github.com/loresmt/loresmt-2021 at commit c22949f578d6; per-pair size = built entry_count, sha256 = sha of the deterministic built corpus. Generated by build_recipe_cards.py from recipes/loresmt2021.json.

excluded.sign_language: LoResMT 2021 also ran a sign-language subtask (data/sign_language/) — out of scope: text-only directive (founder, 2026-07-07).
